name: footballcharts-mcp
display_name: Football Charts — football data for 93 leagues
description: Tables, results, fixtures, goal timing and season projections for 93 football leagues, lower divisions included. No key needed.
long_description:
Give Claude football data for **93 leagues in 42 countries** — top divisions, the lower tiers most sources skip (Spanish regional groups, Czech 2/3, Baltic, Nordic, Asian and African leagues) and women's leagues.

Ten read-only tools: league tables (classic, luck-adjusted, goals), results with half-time scores and first-goal minutes, upcoming fixtures with a public baseline model's probabilities, one-match detail, Monte Carlo season projections (title / top-4 / relegation, 10,000 runs, daily), team pages, goal timing per 15-minute bin, and the settled public track record of every published model lean — losses included.

**Works without an API key** (300 requests/day per IP). A free key from football-charts.com/developers lifts that to 5,000/day. Current and previous season per league; no betting odds — the historical odds archive is a separate dataset at football-charts.com/data.

Statistics, not betting advice. Data by football-charts.com.

tools.name: about_football_charts
tools.description: What this source covers, what it does not, how league keys and seasons work, how to phrase probabilities. Call first when unsure.

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: Turn a league name into its key; see the seasons available.

tools.name: get_league_table
tools.description: Standings, form, expected points; view=luck or goals for alternative rankings.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Finished matches with FT/HT scores and first-goal minute; filter by team, cap with last.

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Upcoming matches with the baseline model's calibrated probabilities across markets.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One upcoming match in full, by slug.

tools.name: get_season_projection
tools.description: Title / top-4 / relegation probabilities and points ranges, 10,000 simulations, daily.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: One team: table row, match log, goal timing, stats.

tools.name: get_goal_timing
tools.description: Goals per 15-minute bin per team with peak_bins; pass team for one team.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: The public settled ledger of every published model lean, losses included.

api_key.title: Football Charts API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to use the keyless tier (300 requests/day). A free key from https://www.football-charts.com/developers gives 5,000/day.
